Board Composition - Till 23.11.2025, our Bank has complied with Board composition requirements. Upon appointment of Executive Director Shri Pramod Kumar Dwibedi on 24.11.2025, the number of Directors on Banks Board has increased to 10, out of which 3 Directors are independent. Hence from 24.11.2025, 1/3rd of the Board composition is not independent.
Audit Committee of Board is non compliant as two-thirds of the members of ACB are not independent directors.
Bank has written to DFS for appointment of Directors to the Board of the Bank to fill the vacancies which will help the Bank in complying with the requirements of the Board composition and composition of Audit Committee of the Board.
